chapter: Boots and His Buddies and Wild Cherry
title: The thrill of hearing himself on a jukebox
summary: Harris says the pay was small, but hearing himself on a jukebox was a thrill.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: It wasn't too much in those days. You know it, what? I know what I got out of mine.

But I mean playing it, that was a kick. That was a thousand dollars right back. Sure. Guys would ask me, how does it feel to walk up and drop a liquor in a jukebox and hear yourself play? I said oh man, there's nothing to it but hell I was thrilling inside you know. It was thrilling inside.
